resources.string: Rests apps when their time is up.
To remove Meadow, first turn this off.
Nothing is shared until you turn it on. Change this at any time in Settings.
Example: your page as a Bumblebee sees it
Add your email to keep your garden on a new phone and to invite Bumblebees.
Next, tap Meadow if you see a list, then turn on \"Permit usage access\".
Next, tap \"Installed apps\" or \"Downloaded apps\", then \"Meadow garden keeper\". Turn it on and tap \"Allow\".
Next, turn on \"Allow notification access\" (or the switch next to Meadow), then tap \"Allow\".
Next, turn on \"Allow display over other apps\".
Greyed out? In App info, tap ⋮ › Allow restricted settings.
This build isn\'t connected to a server. See the README.
Silences notifications and media from resting apps.
Turn on the essentials in Protections first.
Notifications are on. Send a test to make sure they reach this phone.
Notifications for Meadow are off. Chats and requests can\'t reach you.
Sent. Two test notifications come within a minute. If they don\'t come, do the steps below.
This phone can\'t get notifications. Make sure that you\'re online and Google Play services is up to date. Then try again.
Meadow can\'t reach this phone. Try again in a few minutes.
Choose \"Allow\" or \"Unrestricted\" for Meadow, so Android doesn\'t stop it.
In Meadow\'s app info, open Battery (or App battery usage). Allow background activity. If you see \"Pause app activity if unused\", turn it off.
Open recent apps. Touch and hold Meadow (or swipe it down), then choose the lock. Meadow then keeps running when you clear recent apps.
In Security › Autostart, turn on Meadow. Then Meadow starts again after a restart.
In Meadow\'s battery saver settings, choose \"No restrictions\".
Under Other permissions, allow \"Display pop-up windows while running in the background\" and \"Show on lock screen\". Then the resting screen can show.
In App launch, turn off \"Manage automatically\" for Meadow. Then turn on auto-launch, secondary launch and run in background.
In Battery › Background usage limits, add Meadow to \"Never sleeping apps\". Make sure that Meadow isn\'t in sleeping or deep sleeping apps.
In the startup manager, allow Meadow to auto-launch. In Meadow\'s battery settings, allow background activity.
In i Manager › Background startup, allow Meadow. In battery settings, allow high background power use.
In Mobile Manager › Auto-start, allow Meadow.
Strict mode needs unrestricted battery and notification access.
Turn on unrestricted battery and notification access in Protections first.
